'''Project Phlutdroid''' was the codename of the project that resulted in the development of [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] and its [[IG-series/Legends|variations]], including [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]]. The name was derived from that of [[Phlut Design Systems/Legends|Phlut Design Systems]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-era company that produced the [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer combat droid]], on which the design of IG-88 was partially based.

Project Phlutdroid was carried out by the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] of [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]], under the auspices of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supervisor/Legends|Supervisor]] [[Gurdun]]. Unfortunately for Holowan, moments after their activation, the new IG assassin droids embarked on a [[Holowan Massacre|rampage of destruction]] through the laboratory, and eventually escaped to [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]].
